toolDefinitions.name: quantize-list
toolDefinitions.description: List the quantization jobs of the person you are talking to, newest first, including jobs started in the web page. A model can only control jobs it started.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-start
toolDefinitions.description: Start a new quantization job. In a chat it runs at once and the person can undo it; from an API key it is only a proposal that a person confirms. A model can only control jobs it started.

name.description: A label for the job, 1 to 80 characters.

model.description: Model to quantize as a gallery or Hugging Face ID. A local path is refused.

backend.description: Quantization backend. The default is llama-cpp-quantization.

quantizationType.description: Quantization type, such as q4_k_m (lowercase letters, digits and underscores). The default is q4_k_m.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-status
toolDefinitions.description: Show the status of a quantization job that a tool started. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-stop
toolDefinitions.description: Stop a quantization job that a tool started. Stopping cannot be undone. In a chat it runs at once and the person can undo it; from an API key it is only a proposal that a person confirms. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: quantize-import
toolDefinitions.description: Register the result of a quantization job that a tool started as a model. Administrators only. Importing cannot be undone. In a chat it runs at once and the person can undo it; from an API key it is only a proposal that a person confirms. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the quantization job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

name.description: Name of the model, 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Leave out to let the engine choose.

description.en: Shrink a model to a smaller quantized file, then import it so you can chat with it.
description.it: Riduci un modello in un file quantizzato più piccolo, poi importalo per poterci chattare.
description.de: Verkleinern Sie ein Modell zu einer kleineren quantisierten Datei und importieren Sie sie dann, um mit ihr zu chatten.
description.es: Reduce un modelo a un archivo cuantizado más pequeño y luego impórtalo para poder chatear con él.
description.fr: Réduisez un modèle à un fichier quantifié plus petit, puis importez-le pour pouvoir discuter avec lui.
description.pt-BR: Reduza um modelo a um arquivo quantizado menor e depois importe-o para poder conversar com ele.
description.zh-CN: 把模型压缩为更小的量化文件，再导入它，即可与之聊天。
description.ko: 모델을 더 작은 양자화 파일로 줄인 다음 가져와서 채팅할 수 있습니다.
description.id: Perkecil model menjadi berkas terkuantisasi yang lebih kecil, lalu impor agar Anda dapat mengobrol dengannya.
